result.brief: 提出免训练推理框架，通过多帧深度分层渲染与视角条件路由，稳定预训练视频扩散模型在交通场景长时程未来帧预测中的静态几何与结构保真度。
result.reason: Training-free inference framework for long-horizon future-frame video prediction in traffic scenes, using depth-layered rendering and view-conditioned routing; directly targets video world-model prediction and video generation stability.
